verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks for async status monitoring, refusal-reason codes for diagnosing failed payments, and an official MCP server enabling LLM/agent access to its API — giving an agent the building blocks to detect failures. However there is no documented automated retry engine or dunning outreach workflow (e.g., smart retries, subscription recovery flows) that an agent could drive, so the story is only partially supported. Missing for 10: explicit retry/recovery automation, dunning campaign tooling, and evidence of an agent actually orchestrating retries end-to-end.
